notes: Annual encounters are NOT unique patients and may include overlapping service categories.
Loss of contribution margin, not total gross revenue, is used for unrecovered services.
Patient diversion indicators are nonfinancial; no separate dollar penalty is added.
Incident recovery days represent ecosystem disruption, not full network-wide shutdown.
All unit rates and affected shares are synthetic planning assumptions requiring calibration.

assumption_rationale.affected_encounter_fraction: Synthetic share of daily encounters exposed to impaired services, not share of all patient records
assumption_rationale.cancelled_fraction_of_affected: Synthetic portion of affected encounters that cannot be delivered during disruption
assumption_rationale.unrecovered_fraction: Synthetic fraction of cancelled encounters not later rescheduled; only these generate lost contribution
assumption_rationale.service_contribution_margin_usd: Synthetic incremental contribution per encounter; not average revenue or gross charges
assumption_rationale.systems_restored: Illustrative subset of 220 workloads plus connected applications requiring direct recovery; severe count capped at 220
assumption_rationale.reputation_patients_lost: Synthetic distinct future encounters lost after service restoration; excludes immediate cancellations
assumption_rationale.disruption_days: Central duration aligned with the mean of severity-specific triangular recovery-day inputs
assumption_rationale.continuity_daily_capacity_factor: Scale of incremental diversion/temporary-care contracts; not the same as lost encounter margin
assumption_rationale.exposed_records_if_breach: Conditional exposure quantity; notification cost gated by existing severity-specific breach probability
assumption_rationale.loss_variability: Common synthetic cost-uncertainty band, not a confidence interval or independently estimated component distribution
